item.title: In 2018, Matt Holliday paid $3M for Oklahoma land; his 62-acre estate now asks $9.8M
item.description: Former MLB star Matt Holliday's luxurious estate in Oklahoma has hit the market, boasting 62 acres of prime land including a private baseball field with professional-grade lighting. The stunning home, constructed in 2022, offers five spacious bedrooms and seven bathrooms. Among the standout features are a magnificent swimming pool and an indoor sports court. Originally listed for $12 million, it is now available for $9.8 million. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Teen cancer survivor’s LEGO drive donates 573 mini-figures and raises $2,575 for his hospital
item.description: Cancer survivor Alexander Ackles-Dold reminisces about the compassion he received during his childhood hospital stays. In a heartfelt initiative, he spearheads a LEGO donation drive for the pediatric oncology clinic in Southlake. The project has amassed hundreds of LEGO figures and raised considerable funds, striving to offer young patients an engaging escape during their treatments. The Ackles-Dold family continues to gather donations to brighten the spirits of children battling cancer. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Hong Kong court terminates trial after suspect in deadly 1991 hold-up dies of cancer
item.description: A Hong Kong court has terminated a trial arising from a deadly shooting during a botched robbery three decades ago after the defendant died in custody earlier this week. The High Court on Wednesday discharged a seven-member jury presiding over the trial of Wen Wenye, who allegedly took part in the murder and attempted robbery at Shun Fat Company, a second-hand goods shop in Sham Shui Po, on June 9, 1991. A government statement on Monday said Wen, 62, died in hospital that afternoon after he was... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: GSK licenses Chinese firm’s cancer drug in US$750 million deal
item.description: British pharmaceutical giant GSK has agreed to acquire a cancer drug from Chinese firm Chimagen Biosciences in a deal worth up to US$750 million, underscoring China’s emergence as a global player in biotechnology. GSK announced plans on Tuesday to buy full global rights to a “potential best-in-class” T-cell engager (TCE) from Chengdu-based Chimagen, targeting treatment for multiple myeloma, a type of blood cancer. TCEs work by binding T cells, a kind of white blood cell, directly to cancer... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: I remember 2011 well. Indonesia was chairing the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and I was serving as deputy foreign minister for Asean cooperation. item.title: Air pollution linked to higher suicide risk, international research suggests
item.description: Analysis of 29 studies highlights potentially heightened danger from small particulate matter and nitrogen dioxide Air pollution is associated with an increased risk of suicide and suicidal thoughts, according to research. Environmental pollution is known to be associated with poorer mental health but its role in suicide risk is less well understood. Scientists at Queen’s University Belfast examined whether air, noise, light, and water pollution could influence the risk of death by suicide and suicidal behaviours. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Ebola responders grapple with widening outbreak in DR Congo
item.description: The deadly Ebola virus outbreak in DR Congo continues to spread across the vast country despite some success in containing it, aid officials said on Tuesday, in a renewed call for international support to help responders on the ground. Fuente: UN News.

item.title: UN warns Ebola may not have peaked in DR Congo, despite falling cases
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo shows early signs of slowing. Daily infections have decreased from approximately 120 to about 80 cases. However, transmission continues to rise in some areas, officials caution. Mobile data tracks population movements to predict future virus spread. Kisangani has emerged as a key area of concern due to its transport hub status. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Hong Kong visitor arrivals hit post-pandemic monthly high in August
item.description: Hong Kong has recorded its highest monthly number of visitors since the Covid-19 pandemic, provisional official figures show, with authorities attributing August’s total to a series of international conferences and mega-events. The Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Tuesday that the city received 5.46 million visitors across the month, up 6 per cent from a year earlier and the highest monthly total since the pandemic. Tourist numbers in the first eight months of the year also rose 11 per cent year... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: In 1928, Bel-Air founder built this LA mansion; bought for $5.5m in 2010, now listed at $32.5m
item.description: A 1928 mansion built for Alphonzo Bell, the oil businessman who helped create Bel-Air, is now listed for $32.5 million. Michael Wexler bought the Los Angeles home for $5.5 million in 2010 and spent years restoring it. The 10,600-square-foot property now has seven bedrooms, a theatre, pool, wine cellar and 26 newly planted redwood sequoias. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: How a 26-year-old hacker breached 165 companies and exposed 100 million people
item.description: A man from Canada confessed to orchestrating a massive hacking scheme in 2024, which resulted in the breach of sensitive data from over 165 organizations, affecting billions of records. The perpetrators demanded hefty ransoms and trafficked stolen information on cybercrime platforms. International law enforcement cooperation led to his arrest in Canada, and he has now pled guilty to numerous offenses, awaiting sentencing in October. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
